relations.text: 倉庫自動化事業を売却する契約(2025年11月)
relations.text_en: Agreed to buy its warehouse automation business (November 2025)

source.label: Matthews International 10-K(2025年9月期)
source.quote: SUBSEQUENT EVENT: On November 12, 2025, subsequent to the date of the balance sheet, the Company entered into an Equity Purchase Agreement (the "Purchase Agreement") for the sale of its Warehouse Automation business to Duravant LLC, a global leader in engineered equipment and automation solutions.

relations.text: 株式売出しの販売代理人
relations.text_en: Sales agent for its share offering program

source.label: Matthews International 8-K(2025年3月)
source.quote: On March 11, 2025, Matthews International Corporation (the "Company") entered into an equity distribution agreement (the "Equity Distribution Agreement") with Truist Securities, Inc., in its capacity as sales agent (the "Sales Agent"), under which the Company may offer and sell, from time to time, through and to the Sales Agent, up to 1,250,000 shares (the "Shares") of the Company's Class A Common Stock (the "Common Stock").
